Class-parent operators get no @_cdecl wrapper (ShouldEmitOperatorWrapper only wraps frozen-struct parents), so the class operands pass as SafeHandle under CallConvSwift. Both Mono and NativeAOT reject that non-blittable shape with InvalidProgramException before return marshalling runs (Issue 2). The CS0029 return-marshalling fix and the compile gate are proven by the Vector2D fixture; the runtime round-trip needs CallConvCdecl operator wrappers for class parents.
